meta.environment: *fill* (CICS region + DB2 subsystem with ORION.CARD / ORION.TTYP / ORION.CTRL / ORION.TRAN)
meta.author: modernizeX

cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial screen layout, captions and function-key legend on entry
cases.steps:
1. Sign on and select Transaction Add (DB2) from the main menu (transaction OD06)
2. Observe the freshly opened screen without entering anything
cases.expected: The Transaction Add screen is shown 24x80 with the entry captions `Card Num:`, `Type    :`, `Category:`, `Amount  :`, `Merchant:`, `Desc    :`, the header line (Tran / Date / Pgm / Time), the message line, and the key legend `ENTER=Process  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear`.
cases.remark: §2 mockup / BMS map MTRANAA SDD-MAP-031 / caption fields; legend field line 24

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: Header, date/time and guidance message populated on open; entry fields empty
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen (transaction OD06)
2. Read the header line and the message line
cases.expected: The transaction name shows `OD06`, the program name shows `ODTRANA`, the title shows `ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM`, the current date and time are filled, the six entry fields are blank, and the message line shows `Enter transaction detail and press ENTER.`
cases.remark: 1000-SEND-INITIAL + 8000-POPULATE-HEADER; TRNNAMEO=WS-TRANID 'OD06', PGMNAMEO='ODTRANA', TITLEO=WS-HDR-TITLE (WHEAD); msg literal L66

cases.mid: 表示条件・活性制御 (Display conditions / enable control)
cases.name: Entry fields enterable with initial focus; header and message line are display-only
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Tab through the fields and check which accept input
cases.expected: Card Num, Type, Category, Amount, Merchant and Desc accept input (Card Num holds the initial cursor); the header fields, date/time and the message line are protected (display-only) and cannot be typed into.
cases.remark: §2 item states; CARDNUM attr UNPROT/IC/FSET (initial cursor), header fields ASKIP/NORM

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Add a valid transaction end-to-end and receive the success confirmation
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00, Merchant = AMAZON.COM, Desc = ONLINE ORDER
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card Num=4000123412341234; Type=01; Category=0001; Amount=100.00; Merchant=AMAZON.COM; Desc=ONLINE ORDER
cases.expected: The entry passes validation, the card and type are confirmed to exist, a new transaction row is created in the transaction table, and the message line shows `Transaction added. Id=0000000000000101` (next id from the control counter, 100+1).
cases.remark: 2100-ADD-TRAN happy chain (3000/3100/3200/3300/3400); success STRING L109 into ERRMSGO; INSERT ORION.TRAN

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Optional Merchant and Desc left blank still creates the transaction
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 50.00, leaving Merchant and Desc blank
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card Num=4000123412341234; Type=01; Category=0001; Amount=50.00; Merchant=(blank); Desc=(blank)
cases.expected: The transaction is still created (Merchant and Desc are not validated) and the message line shows `Transaction added. Id=0000000000000101`; the stored merchant name and description are blank.
cases.remark: 2200-EDIT-INPUT validates only CARDNUM/TRTYPE/TRCAT/TRAMT; TRMERCH/TRDESC unchecked

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Transaction id is taken from the control counter, incremented and persisted
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Add a valid transaction (Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00)
3. Press ENTER, then inspect the control counter
cases.expected: The new transaction is assigned id `0000000000000101` (counter 100 + 1) and the control counter for key `TRANID` is updated to `101`, so the next add would receive `102`.
cases.remark: 3200-GET-NEXT-ID: SELECT CT_LAST_VALUE ORION.CTRL WHERE CT_KEY='TRANID'; ADD 1; UPDATE ORION.CTRL

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Control row absent: id defaults to 1
cases.precondition: F-STD, except the control table has NO row for key TRANID.
cases.steps:
1. Remove the control row for key TRANID
2. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen and add a valid transaction (Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00)
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: Because no counter is found, the id defaults to 1 and the message line shows `Transaction added. Id=0000000000000001`.
cases.remark: 3200-GET-NEXT-ID ELSE branch (SQLCODE not 0) sets WS-CT-VALUE=1; see NOTES observation on duplicate-key risk

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Amount with decimals is parsed and stored; origin/processing timestamps stamped
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.50
3. Press ENTER, then inspect the stored transaction
cases.expected: The amount is parsed to the numeric value `100.50` and stored; the origin and processing timestamps are set to the current date and time; source is stored as `ONLINE`.
cases.remark: 3300-BUILD-RECORD: COMPUTE TR-AMT = FUNCTION NUMVAL(TRAMTI); TR-ORIG-TS/TR-PROC-TS from 8500-GET-DATE-TIME; TR-SOURCE='ONLINE'

cases.name: Created transaction row carries the correct column values
cases.steps:
1. Add a valid transaction (Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00, Merchant = AMAZON.COM, Desc = ONLINE ORDER)
2. Press ENTER
3. Read back the newly created transaction row
cases.data: Card Num=4000123412341234; Type=01; Category=0001; Amount=100.00; Merchant=AMAZON.COM; Desc=ONLINE ORDER
cases.expected: The stored row holds: id = `0000000000000101`, type = `01`, category = `0001`, source = `ONLINE`, amount = `100.00`, card = `4000123412341234`, merchant name = `AMAZON.COM`, description = `ONLINE ORDER`; merchant id = `000000000`, merchant city and zip blank; origin and processing timestamps set.
cases.remark: 3400-INSERT-TRAN INSERT ORION.TRAN columns (RTRAN SDD-CPY-072): TR-MERCHANT-ID=ZEROS, TR-MERCHANT-CITY/ZIP=SPACES

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Two consecutive adds create two distinct rows with consecutive ids
cases.steps:
1. Add a valid transaction (Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00) and press ENTER
2. Without leaving the screen, add a second valid transaction (Amount = 200.00) and press ENTER
3. Inspect the transaction table
cases.expected: Two separate transaction rows exist with ids `0000000000000101` and `0000000000000102`; each ENTER creates a new record (the operation is not idempotent), and the control counter ends at `102`.
cases.remark: Each 2100-ADD-TRAN performs a fresh 3200 (+1)/3400 INSERT; no dedup guard

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF3 cancels and returns to the main menu
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Press PF3 (Back)
cases.expected: The screen is cancelled without creating any transaction and control is handed to the main menu (OCMENU).
cases.remark: 2000 WHEN DFHPF3 -> 7000-XCTL-MENU: XCTL PROGRAM(WS-MENU-PGM='OCMENU')

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the entered values and restarts the entry
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen and type Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Amount = 100.00
2. Press PF4 (Clear)
cases.expected: All entry fields are cleared, the screen is redisplayed fresh with the message line `Enter transaction detail and press ENTER.`, and no transaction is created.
cases.remark: 2000 WHEN DFHPF4 -> 1000-SEND-INITIAL (MOVE LOW-VALUES to MTRANAAO)

cases.name: Pseudo-conversational re-entry stays on the same transaction
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen (first entry, no prior context)
2. Enter a valid transaction (Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00) and press ENTER
3. Observe the returned screen
cases.expected: First entry shows the initial screen; after ENTER the same Transaction Add screen (transaction OD06) is redisplayed with the result message, so the operator can add another transaction without re-navigating.
cases.remark: 0000-MAIN EIBCALEN=0 / CA-FIRST-ENTER -> 1000; else 2000; 9000-RETURN TRANSID('OD06'); CA-PGM-CONTEXT=1 after initial

cases.name: Card number left blank is rejected
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Leave Card Num blank, enter Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The entry is rejected before any table access and the message line shows `Card number is required.`; no transaction is created.
cases.remark: 2200-EDIT-INPUT L126-128 CARDNUMI = SPACES/LOW-VALUES -> INPUT-INVALID

cases.name: Transaction type left blank is rejected
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, leave Type blank, enter Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The entry is rejected and the message line shows `Transaction type is required.`; no transaction is created.
cases.remark: 2200-EDIT-INPUT L131-133 TRTYPEI = SPACES/LOW-VALUES

cases.name: Category left blank is rejected as non-numeric
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, leave Category blank, enter Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The entry is rejected and the message line shows `Category must be numeric.`; no transaction is created.
cases.remark: 2200-EDIT-INPUT L137 TRCATI = SPACES OR TRCATI NOT NUMERIC (blank trigger)

cases.name: Category with letters is rejected as non-numeric
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = AB, Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The entry is rejected and the message line shows `Category must be numeric.`; no transaction is created.
cases.remark: 2200-EDIT-INPUT L137 TRCATI NOT NUMERIC (non-numeric trigger, distinct from blank)

cases.name: Amount left blank is rejected
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, leave Amount blank
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The entry is rejected and the message line shows `Amount is required.`; no transaction is created.
cases.remark: 2200-EDIT-INPUT L143-145 TRAMTI = SPACES/LOW-VALUES

cases.name: Validation stops at the first failing field
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Leave Card Num blank AND leave Amount blank, enter Type = 01, Category = 0001
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: Only the first failing field is reported: the message line shows `Card number is required.` and stops (the blank Amount is not reported until Card Num is corrected).
cases.remark: Each 2200 check guarded by IF INPUT-VALID -> only first failure sets the message

cases.name: Card number not present in the card master
cases.precondition: F-STD (card 9999888877776666 does NOT exist in the card master).
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 9999888877776666, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The card lookup finds no matching card and the message line shows `Card number not found.`; no transaction is created.
cases.remark: 3000-CHECK-CARD SELECT ORION.CARD SQLCODE=100 -> REC-NOT-FOUND; message set at 2100 L119

cases.name: Transaction type not present in the type master
cases.precondition: F-STD (type 99 does NOT exist in the type master; card 4000123412341234 exists).
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 99, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The card is found but the type lookup finds no matching type and the message line shows `Transaction type not found.`; no transaction is created.
cases.remark: 3100-CHECK-TYPE SELECT ORION.TTYP SQLCODE=100 -> REC-NOT-FOUND; message set at 2100 L116

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Card table read failure is reported
cases.precondition: F-STD, but the card table read returns a database error (not found / not zero) — e.g. table unavailable or authorization failure.
cases.steps:
1. Force a database error on the card table read (e.g. revoke access / table stopped)
2. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen and enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: card table read -> SQL error (non-zero, non-100); Card Num=4000123412341234
cases.expected: The read error is caught and the message line shows `Error reading card table.`; no transaction is created.
cases.remark: 3000-CHECK-CARD EVALUATE SQLCODE WHEN OTHER L166-167

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Type table read failure is reported
cases.precondition: F-STD (card 4000123412341234 exists), but the type table read returns a database error.
cases.steps:
1. Force a database error on the type table read (e.g. table stopped)
2. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen and enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: type table read -> SQL error (non-zero, non-100)
cases.expected: The read error is caught and the message line shows `Error reading type table.`; no transaction is created.
cases.remark: 3100-CHECK-TYPE EVALUATE SQLCODE WHEN OTHER L187-188

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Transaction insert failure is reported
cases.precondition: F-STD, but the insert into the transaction table returns a database error (e.g. duplicate id, tablespace full).
cases.steps:
1. Arrange the transaction table so the insert fails (e.g. a row already holds id 0000000000000101)
2. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen and enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: insert -> SQL error (non-zero); id collision on 0000000000000101
cases.expected: The insert failure is caught and the message line shows `Error inserting transaction row.`; the transaction is not committed.
cases.remark: 3400-INSERT-TRAN EVALUATE SQLCODE WHEN OTHER L255-256; see NOTES id-gap observation

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Unsupported key is rejected
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Press an unsupported key, e.g. PF12
cases.expected: The screen is redisplayed and the message line shows `Invalid key pressed. Please try again.`; no transaction is created.
cases.remark: 2000 EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN OTHER L86-88 MOVE WS-MSG-INVALID-KEY (WMSG SDD-CPY-078)

cases.name: Card number at full 16-digit length is accepted
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter the full 16-digit Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The full-length card is matched in the card master and the transaction is created with `Transaction added. Id=0000000000000101`.
cases.remark: CARDNUM BMS length 16; CD_NUM CHAR(16); TR-CARD-NUM X(16)

cases.name: Card number shorter than 16 digits is treated as not found
cases.precondition: F-STD (no card master row matches the space-padded short value).
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000 (4 digits), Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The short value is space-padded to 16 characters and does not match any card, so the message line shows `Card number not found.`; no transaction is created.
cases.remark: CARDNUMI X(16) padded; 3000-CHECK-CARD exact key match SQLCODE=100

cases.name: Transaction type at full 2-character length is accepted
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01 (2 characters, field max), Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The 2-character type is matched in the type master and the transaction is created.
cases.remark: TRTYPE BMS length 2; TT_CD CHAR(2); TR-TYPE-CD X(02)

cases.name: Category minimum 0000 is accepted
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0000, Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: Category `0000` passes the numeric check and the transaction is created with category `0000`.
cases.remark: TRCAT numeric; TR-CAT-CD 9(04) / DECIMAL(4,0) min

cases.name: Category maximum 9999 is accepted
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 9999, Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: Category `9999` passes the numeric check and the transaction is created with category `9999`.
cases.remark: TR-CAT-CD 9(04) / DECIMAL(4,0) max

cases.name: Amount at maximum magnitude is accepted
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 999999999.99
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The maximum amount `999999999.99` is parsed and stored, and the transaction is created.
cases.remark: TRAMT BMS length 12; TR-AMT S9(09)V99 / DECIMAL(11,2) max; NUMVAL

cases.name: Amount of zero is accepted
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 0.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: Amount=0.00 (zero boundary; field non-blank so passes required check)
cases.expected: Amount `0.00` is non-blank so it passes the required check, is parsed to zero and stored, and the transaction is created.
cases.remark: TRAMTI not SPACES -> passes 2200 required; NUMVAL('0.00')=0

cases.name: Negative amount is accepted by the signed amount field
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = -100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: Amount=-100.00 (signed; no rule forbids a negative)
cases.expected: The amount is parsed to `-100.00` (the amount field is signed and there is no rule rejecting a negative) and the transaction is created.
cases.remark: TR-AMT S9(09)V99 signed / DECIMAL(11,2); NUMVAL parses sign; no negative-value check in 2200

cases.name: Merchant name at full 50-character length is accepted
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00, Merchant = a 50-character name (e.g. ABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJ)
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The full 50-character merchant name is stored as entered and the transaction is created.
cases.remark: TRMERCH BMS length 50; TR-MERCHANT-NAME X(50) / CHAR(50)

cases.name: Description at full 50-character length is accepted
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction Add (DB2) screen
2. Enter Card Num = 4000123412341234, Type = 01, Category = 0001, Amount = 100.00, Desc = a 50-character description (e.g. ABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJ)
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The 50-character description is stored (the description column holds up to 100 characters) and the transaction is created.
cases.remark: TRDESC BMS length 50; TR-DESC X(100) / CHAR(100) target
